# Gary Stow

> Performance marketing specialist and AI practitioner. Builds AI agents
> and automated systems, teaches AI skills to colleagues and industry
> audiences, and writes about practical AI adoption in performance
> marketing.

Gary Stow is a Senior Client Solutions Manager in performance marketing,
self-taught in Python and GitHub, building AI agents and automation as
personal projects alongside his day job. This site documents that work:
a live, fully automated momentum trading scanner, an automation team of
department, supervisor and manager roles that watches and improves that
system, a local LLM assistant, AI agents built for practical workflows,
and training delivered to colleagues and industry audiences including
the IAB UK.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://garystow.co.uk/): overview, about, and links to work,
  agents, articles, speaking and contact.
- [Work](https://garystow.co.uk/work/): the Momentum Scanner, a fully
  automated momentum trading system built from scratch, including how
  it works and the skills demonstrated.
- [AI & Agents](https://garystow.co.uk/agents/): AI agents built at work,
  plus AI training, workshops and coaching delivered to colleagues and
  industry audiences.
- [Articles](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/): republished, longer
  versions of LinkedIn posts on building in public, AI and search, and
  performance marketing.

## Recent articles

- [The Speed of Change in Search Driven by AI](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/the-speed-of-change-in-search-driven-by-ai/):
  how quickly new technologies and business models are being adopted
  into search, across advertising, pricing and partnership ecosystems.
- [I Tried to Prove the 'AI Made Me Money' Posts Wrong](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/ai-made-me-money-claims-tested/):
  testing viral "seed fund and a goal" AI trading claims against a real
  automated trading system, with a manager, supervisor and department
  structure, and a local LLM, plus the real bugs found along the way.
- [No, You Don't Need to Spend Thousands a Month to Actually Use AI](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/local-ai-without-the-token-bill/):
  a response to LinkedIn complaints about AI token costs, arguing the
  limiting factor is deciding what genuinely needs a paid model versus
  what a free local model already handles.
- [How to Actually Build Your Own Local AI Assistant](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/build-your-own-local-ai-assistant/):
  a beginner's guide to a fully local, free-tools voice assistant:
  checking VRAM, installing LM Studio, picking a model, running the local
  server, system prompts, wake words, and speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All content on this site reflects Gary's own personal views and
  projects, not those of any employer.
- Specific employers, clients, and internal systems are described in
  general terms only, in line with normal workplace confidentiality.
- Gary is currently focused on training and speaking, not paid
  consulting engagements.
- Any trading results referenced (e.g. account performance figures) are
  from a demo account and are presented as evidence of a working system,
  not as financial advice or investment performance claims.
